quest.title: After Repose
quest.description: It's been some time since your last meeting. You and Paimon are invited to go camping with Cyno, Tighnari, and Collei.
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x400, Mora x31125, Hero's Wit x4, Mystic Enhancement Ore x7

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: We're here! Wow, you guys are ahead of the game — you've set up the tents already!

dialogues.speaker: Tighnari
dialogues.text: I'd say we're right about on schedule, actually. We were aiming to have them set up before you arrived.

dialogues.speaker: Collei
dialogues.text: #{NICKNAME}, Paimon, let's go fishing together! Whatever we catch, we can grill for dinner tonight.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: You got it! Dinner's on us tonight, hehe!

dialogues.speaker: Collei
dialogues.text: I hope I can contribute too! The other Forest Watchers gave me some fishing tips a little while ago. I'm really looking forward to giving them a try!

dialogues.speaker: Tighnari
dialogues.text: I saw some very appetizing mushrooms in the area, so I gathered a few for us. I'll leave them here along with some fresh fruit.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wow, camping with a Forest Watcher is the way to go! They think of everything — and even if they don't, they can improvise!

dialogues.speaker: Cyno
dialogues.text: This is true. I don't think I've ever had a single rough day in this forest.

dialogues.speaker: Tighnari
dialogues.text: So, how has everything been going for you?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hmm... Well, there's been high points and low points, but we've had some unforgettable experiences along the way.

dialogues.speaker: Tighnari
dialogues.text: I see... In that case, you should try a Valberry. I bought some from the market this morning.

dialogues.speaker: Cyno
dialogues.text: A VAL-uable suggestion. Just don't "berry" your feelings using food.

dialogues.speaker: Tighnari
dialogues.text: ...All I wanted was to recommend something bittersweet.

dialogues.speaker: Collei
dialogues.text: Ooh, I have a sudden craving for fruit tea! I'm gonna go fetch some stuff, bye!

dialogues.speaker: Tighnari
dialogues.text: (She sure made a run for it...)

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: (She made a run for it.)

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: (Unbelievable! She made a run for it!)

dialogues.speaker: Cyno
dialogues.text: Hmph, so Collei chose the path of tactical retreat. Could it be that she foresaw what shall soon come to pass...

dialogues.speaker: Cyno
dialogues.text: My dear friend. You know what I am about to say.

response.speaker: Tighnari
response.text: Heh...

response.speaker: Cyno
response.text: Excellent! A kindred spirit. A great warrior can sense when a duel is nigh.

response.speaker: Cyno
response.text: ...But it looks like we'll get told off if we start playing now. Let's enjoy the nature for a while longer.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: (Birds chirping away, the soothing sound of running water... This is nice. No agenda, just relax and enjoy myself.)

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Ah, we got a bite!

response.speaker: Cyno
response.text: I'll reel it in.

response.speaker: Tighnari
response.text: Firewood, spices, snacks, and drinks... Everything's ready. Once Collei gets back, we can light up the fire and start grilling.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: (...This is so relaxing.)

response.speaker: Player
response.text: (It's just so nice to go camping with friends.)

response.speaker: Tighnari
response.text: There are three tents, which one do you two wanna take?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: How about the one on the left?

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Whatever Paimon says.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Well, Paimon just thinks the ambience here is a little better.

response.speaker: Tighnari
response.text: Hmm, true, but it's also the closest to the water. If there are any sleepwalking fungi around tonight, they might stumble into your tent.

response.speaker: Cyno
response.text: Hmm, well that's no good... Take my weapon. You can use it to bar the entrance.

response.speaker: Tighnari
response.text: Anyone would think you were sealing the gates to King Deshret's Mausoleum.

response.speaker: Cyno
response.text: Excellent. Then this tent will be an impenetrable fortress.

response.speaker: Collei
response.text: I'm back! How's your appetites? Ready for the barbecue?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Always!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Oh, it smells so good... Paimon's drooling...

response.speaker: Tighnari
response.text: Someone sure is desperate to eat. Hmm, I think it's time to add the seasoning. How do you like your skewers? Well-done? Medium? Rare?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: ...Wait, what? Isn't that just for steaks?

response.speaker: Collei
response.text: Hey, if it works for steak, maybe it works for other things too.

response.speaker: Cyno
response.text: Medium-well for me!

response.speaker: Tighnari
response.text: Okay, these are about ready now, then... It'll be a few more minutes for anyone who wants theirs well-done.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Well, I'm gonna dig in!

response.speaker: Black Screen
response.text: Everyone wolfs down the delicious food...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: That was so delicious! If Paimon's stomach had space, she'd eat three more skewers!

response.speaker: Collei
response.text: I ate a lot, too. Here comes the food coma...

response.speaker: Cyno
response.text: If you're tired, then go rest.

response.speaker: Tighnari
response.text: You must be getting sleepy too, Paimon. Why don't you guys head to your tents? Cyno and I will clean up.

response.speaker: Cyno
response.text: Tonight, I show you mercy. Our sacred duel will take place another day.

response.speaker: Collei
response.text: *yawn*... Good night!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Whew... Paimon's struggling to keep her eyes open...

response.speaker: Cyno
response.text: Oh, don't forget this. The Staff of the Scarlet Sands.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Wait, you were actually being serious about that!?

response.speaker: Cyno
response.text: It's a very powerful weapon. Try it.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Paimon can't even lift that thing!

response.speaker: Cyno
response.text: Fair enough... You sure you don't want it?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #Yes, Paimon's sure! We'll be fine. And even if we do get an uninvited guest in the night, Paimon will be here to take care of {NICKNAME}.

choices.text: Let's not forget I have my own trusty sword...

response.speaker: Cyno
response.text: Heh, that reminds of a part in "King of Invokations." I'll tell you about it tomorrow.

response.speaker: Cyno
response.text: But right now, it's time to rest. Sleep well, and sweet dreams.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: (This camping trip has really relaxed me. I'm gonna sleep like a baby tonight.)

response.speaker: Black Screen
response.text: In the peace and tranquility of the forest, nature's warm embrace lulls you into a restful sleep...

choices.text: A divine artifact, slayer of countless vile monsters...

response.speaker: Cyno
response.text: Drat. A flat-out rejection.

response.speaker: Cyno
response.text: But this isn't over! It's only a matter of time before I challenge you again... So be ready.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: This guy... Somebody make it stop...

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Alright, alright...

talks.objective: Go to the east side of Gandharva Ville

dialogues.speaker: Kaveh
dialogues.text: ...Huh? Where'd the wine cups go? I could have sworn I left them here after I washed them...

dialogues.speaker: Kaveh
dialogues.text: ...Ah, there they are.

dialogues.speaker: Alhaitham
dialogues.text: I'll have a cup, too.

dialogues.speaker: Kaveh
dialogues.text: Can you see if the cookies are still on the table?

dialogues.speaker: Alhaitham
dialogues.text: They are, and so are the fruits.

dialogues.speaker: Kaveh
dialogues.text: Hmm... Ugh, this is so bland... I should have gotten a few bottles of what Cyno's group was drinking last night.

dialogues.speaker: Alhaitham
dialogues.text: Do tell. What were they drinking?

dialogues.speaker: Kaveh
dialogues.text: #Oh right, I forgot to mention. So, I ran into Cyrus yesterday evening when I went to the tavern to pick up some things. He was hosting a dinner for Cyno, Tighnari, Collei, and {NICKNAME} and Paimon.

dialogues.speaker: Kaveh
dialogues.text: Anyway, they got a bottle of Lambad's new vintage for the table. At least, I think that's what it was. It looked pretty good.

dialogues.speaker: Alhaitham
dialogues.text: Sounds like they're all tangled up in this.

dialogues.speaker: Kaveh
dialogues.text: You know what it's about, right? Sixteen-year-old kid, tried to extort Cyrus? He was asking for ten million Mora.

dialogues.speaker: Alhaitham
dialogues.text: I heard some people talking about it on the streets, yes. Didn't take them long to catch the culprit. The sages are probably dealing with the case by now.

dialogues.speaker: Kaveh
dialogues.text: *sigh* I wonder what Sir Naphis and the others will make of it.

dialogues.speaker: Kaveh
dialogues.text: Oh, Cyrus showed me the extortion letter, too. It was crudely written, but the paper had this beautiful pattern on it that I've never seen before. Really caught my eye.

dialogues.speaker: Kaveh
dialogues.text: Gimme a sec, I'll sketch it out for you.

dialogues.speaker: Kaveh
dialogues.text: ...Okay, done. Take a look.

dialogues.speaker: Kaveh
dialogues.text: You see what I mean? I don't think I've ever seen writing paper like this around before. God knows where the culprit got it from.

dialogues.speaker: Alhaitham
dialogues.text: Interesting. These are all motifs associated with the tribes of the desert.

dialogues.speaker: Kaveh
dialogues.text: What? Really?

dialogues.speaker: Alhaitham
dialogues.text: Take this, for instance. Looks like an outline of a spire, similar to the kind found on some ancient palaces. And the crisscrossing and mirroring here, I recognize that too.

dialogues.speaker: Alhaitham
dialogues.text: It bears a striking resemblance to an ancient emblem. One that hasn't been used in a very long time.

dialogues.speaker: Kaveh
dialogues.text: Whose emblem is it?

dialogues.speaker: Alhaitham
dialogues.text: It's the emblem of the Temple of Silence.

talks.objective: Return to the tent and rest

dialogues.speaker: Kaveh
dialogues.text: ...I think they should all be here.

dialogues.speaker: Kaveh
dialogues.text: #{NICKNAME}, Paimon? Are you in there? Could you come outside for a sec?

dialogues.speaker: Alhaitham
dialogues.text: Look at this.

dialogues.speaker: Kaveh
dialogues.text: What the... What's this sword doing here? Is it supposed to keep out intruders?

dialogues.speaker: Alhaitham
dialogues.text: Evidently.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh? Who is it...? What time do you call this?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: (Those voices... I recognize them.)

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Paimon's going to take out the sword! Hyah...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: (...I'm going back to sleep.)

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Alhaitham? Kaveh? What are you doing here? It's the middle of the night!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: (Huh? Why'd they come all the way out here?)

dialogues.speaker: Kaveh
dialogues.text: Sorry to wake you up at this hour of the night, but we've got a situation on our hands.

dialogues.speaker: Tighnari
dialogues.text: Let's get dressed, and talk about it outside.

dialogues.speaker: Alhaitham
dialogues.text: Something has come up. And since it pertains to Cyrus and Cyno, I deemed it essential to inform you all.

dialogues.speaker: Kaveh
dialogues.text: Whoa, whoa, back up! Let's start from the beginning...

talks.objective: Return to the tent and rest
Return to the tent and rest

dialogues.speaker: Kaveh
dialogues.text: After discussing it with each other, we both agreed that something didn't feel right. So we went looking for you.

dialogues.speaker: Kaveh
dialogues.text: This was a long way to come from the city... Alhaitham figured that you were probably with Tighnari, so Gandharva Ville was our first stop. But the Forest Watchers told us that you'd gone camping.

dialogues.speaker: Kaveh
dialogues.text: Then, just as we were heading off to the camp site, we ran into Cyno. He said he was on a supply run. We exchanged a few words, and then he ran off!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hold on, so what's the deal with that emblem you were talking about? The Temple of Silence, you said? What is that? Should we be worried?

dialogues.speaker: Tighnari
dialogues.text: Something's up, huh? Give me a second, let me get Collei.

dialogues.speaker: Alhaitham
dialogues.text: So you've never heard of the Temple of Silence? Well, to put it simply, it's an organization that has existed in Sumeru for over a thousand years.

dialogues.speaker: Alhaitham
dialogues.text: These days, you can find a Temple of Silence office in the Akademiya. Theoretically, it's responsible for the custody and disposal of information and documents not fit for public dissemination.

dialogues.speaker: Alhaitham
dialogues.text: At least, that's what they tell the outside world. In truth, it's essentially a vestigial institution nowadays. There's an office with their name on it, but it's functionally obsolete.

dialogues.speaker: Alhaitham
dialogues.text: Historically speaking, the original Temple of Silence is said to have been established by Hermanubis, one of the Seven Pillars of King Deshret and the greatest of all sages. Most of the organization's members hailed from the desert.

dialogues.speaker: Alhaitham
dialogues.text: By contrast, none of the Akademiya Temple's current members are from the desert region. Nor do they use any symbols connected with the desert folk.

dialogues.speaker: Collei
dialogues.text: So the Temple of Silence at the Akademiya is just a fake? Wow...

dialogues.speaker: Alhaitham
dialogues.text: It's possible. The real question is why. My guess is, they're covering something up.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: So how do you know all this? Sounds like some pretty top-secret stuff.

dialogues.speaker: Kaveh
dialogues.text: Did you forget? He did a stint as Acting Grand Sage. And kept the pay raise even after he resigned.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh yeah, Paimon did totally forget about that... So you took the chance to read all the top-secret documents while you were Acting Grand Sage, huh?

dialogues.speaker: Alhaitham
dialogues.text: If you're asking me whether I familiarized myself with the documentation in my office, I would respond that that's a perfectly normal part of any job.

dialogues.speaker: Kaveh
dialogues.text: So much about this doesn't make sense. Why did the emblem of the Temple of Silence appear on a threat letter from an Akademiya student to Cyrus?

dialogues.speaker: Kaveh
dialogues.text: The student's only sixteen, and doesn't have any family ties to the desert. So where could he have seen that emblem, or gotten the paper?

dialogues.speaker: Tighnari
dialogues.text: You said you ran into Cyno, yes? Did you tell him what you've just told us?

dialogues.speaker: Kaveh
dialogues.text: Yep. He ran off as soon as he heard what we said.

dialogues.speaker: Tighnari
dialogues.text: Given that Cyrus is involved, he's probably halfway through solving the case by now...

dialogues.speaker: Tighnari
dialogues.text: Still, we should try to catch up with him. At this hour of the night, Cyno will probably go looking for Cyrus at his current residence.

dialogues.speaker: Kaveh
dialogues.text: Hmm, if the Akademiya's Temple of Silence really does exist just to cover up the truth, the sudden appearance of this emblem can't be good. It's sure to stir up trouble...

dialogues.speaker: Kaveh
dialogues.text: We should pay a visit to the Akademiya.

dialogues.speaker: Tighnari
dialogues.text: Yes. As the sage of Amurta, my master ought to know the truth about their office. You can ask him to tell you what he knows. The more information we have, the better prepared we'll be for whatever happens there.

dialogues.speaker: Alhaitham
dialogues.text: If this situation is connected to the real Temple of Silence, the emblem has to be part of a bigger conspiracy.

dialogues.speaker: Tighnari
dialogues.text: Collei, could I trouble you to send a message to the Corps of Thirty? Tell them to keep an eye out for Cyno and Cyrus.

dialogues.speaker: Tighnari
dialogues.text: #{NICKNAME}, Paimon, you two come with me. We'll go after Cyno.

dialogues.speaker: Kaveh
dialogues.text: Sounds like a plan. Let's go.

dialogues.speaker: Tighnari
dialogues.text: Here we are. This is the place.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: We might be too late. Looks like nobody's home...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Cyno moves fast. If he was here, he's probably long gone by now...

dialogues.speaker: Zaha Hadi
dialogues.text: I know that voice... Is that Tighnari I hear?

dialogues.speaker: Tighnari
dialogues.text: Ah, Professor Zaha Hadi!

dialogues.speaker: Zaha Hadi
dialogues.text: Wow, so it really is you. My goodness, whatever is going on tonight?

dialogues.speaker: Tighnari
dialogues.text: We're looking for Cyno... So he's already been here?

dialogues.speaker: Zaha Hadi
dialogues.text: Yes, not long ago, in fact. He knocked on my door, and asked if I'd seen Cyrus today at all.

dialogues.speaker: Zaha Hadi
dialogues.text: I told him that the old fool left early this morning, and I hadn't heard him come back. So we went to his place, and would you believe it — he's gone! Goodness knows where to.

dialogues.speaker: Zaha Hadi
dialogues.text: It must have alarmed Cyno, because he took off in an awful hurry after that. He never did explain what this was all about... *sigh* How serious is it?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Well, if Cyrus isn't at home... it sure doesn't sound good...

dialogues.speaker: Tighnari
dialogues.text: Professor, did you hear that a student recently tried to extort Cyrus?

dialogues.speaker: Zaha Hadi
dialogues.text: Why, yes. When I left the house that day, I noticed he was watering his flowers in the field in complete silence. He had a piece of paper clutched in his hand, and he looked lost in thought.

dialogues.speaker: Zaha Hadi
dialogues.text: I could tell something was troubling him, but he wouldn't tell me what it was. If Cyno hadn't happened to visit him that day, he'd probably still be holding onto that thing.

dialogues.speaker: Zaha Hadi
dialogues.text: After seeing the letter, Cyno told him to contact the Corps of Thirty, but Cyrus was very reluctant. He claimed it would only damage his reputation. Eventually, he relented, after much persuasion from Cyno.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh? Cyrus didn't want to report it? Well, that's strange. When we saw him, he seemed pretty okay with the idea of the kid getting his just deserts...

dialogues.speaker: Zaha Hadi
dialogues.text: As a former sage, it's possible Cyrus still has enemies at the Akademiya. That's why Cyno was so insistent that he report the matter to the authorities. I was there while they were going back and forth over it.

dialogues.speaker: Tighnari
dialogues.text: (So, Cyrus initially hoped to stop this from going public... But why?)

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: (He only reported it because Cyno forced him to. Which means... Cyrus must know something about the Temple of Silence.)

dialogues.speaker: Zaha Hadi
dialogues.text: Oh dear... What on earth has that old fool gotten himself wrapped up in? I do hope he's not in danger...

dialogues.speaker: Zaha Hadi
dialogues.text: Oh, I almost forgot — Cyno left me this letter to pass onto you. He wrote it when he came by earlier. He realized you might come looking for him.

dialogues.speaker: Tighnari
dialogues.text: Thank you.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: What does it say? Let Paimon take a look...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: "My friends, this is a rather complicated state of affair. Unfortunately, I cannot disclose more than that. I ask you to understand and accept that I had to act alone at this stage. Don't come after me."

dialogues.speaker: Tighnari
dialogues.text: Yep, that sounds like Cyno... Thank you, Professor. Please do not worry — we will do all we can to protect both Cyno and Cyrus.

dialogues.speaker: Tighnari
dialogues.text: #{NICKNAME}, Paimon, let's head to the Akademiya and regroup.

dialogues.speaker: Kaveh
dialogues.text: You're here? I thought you were going after... Ah, I guess you lost their trail.

dialogues.speaker: Tighnari
dialogues.text: We went to Cyrus's house. No one was there. Cyno got there before us, but he was long gone by the time we arrived.

dialogues.speaker: Kaveh
dialogues.text: He didn't say where he was going?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: No. He left us a letter, and told us to not go after him.

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: Tighnari shares what you learned from Zaha Hadi.

dialogues.speaker: Alhaitham
dialogues.text: Can't say I'm surprised.

dialogues.speaker: Kaveh
dialogues.text: *sigh* Typical Cyno...

dialogues.speaker: Kaveh
dialogues.text: Anyway, some updates on progress on our end — I drew the emblem from memory again, but in more detail this time.

dialogues.speaker: Alhaitham
dialogues.text: I checked some ancient texts for a similar design. The one I found was a little blurry, but the similarities in the general form and certain details were clear enough to confirm a match.

dialogues.speaker: Kaveh
dialogues.text: Yeah, and we're lucky we found anything at all. Turns out the emblem was all but lost to history. We scoured the entire Akademiya collection, and that book was the only one with a record of the motif.

dialogues.speaker: Alhaitham
dialogues.text: Meanwhile, Aarav managed to get Urraca to disclose his source.

dialogues.speaker: Alhaitham
dialogues.text: The one who told him about Cyrus's embezzled funds was a young man from the desert. According to Urraca, he had a striking presence and was well educated.

dialogues.speaker: Kaveh
dialogues.text: Apparently, the two met in the tavern over a game of cards. The guy claimed to be in the city for business, as part of a merchant caravan.

dialogues.speaker: Kaveh
dialogues.text: Urraca was intrigued when he heard what his new acquaintance had to say, and brought up the idea of extorting Cyrus for Mora. The guy encouraged him to go ahead with it, then handed him some pen and paper to write the letter.

dialogues.speaker: Tighnari
dialogues.text: I see... So it could be that this person planted the paper intentionally.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: So how do we find this guy? Did Urraca say where he is?

dialogues.speaker: Kaveh
dialogues.text: He doesn't know. He claims not to have seen him since that day in the tavern. The man gave him some tips on how to carry out the extortion, but from then on Urraca was acting alone.

dialogues.speaker: Alhaitham
dialogues.text: Naphis and Aarav have gone to meet the Corps of Thirty and review the city's entry and exit records.

dialogues.speaker: Alhaitham
dialogues.text: Also, Naphis admitted that the Temple of Silence in the Akademiya is just a facade.

dialogues.speaker: Alhaitham
dialogues.text: The true Temple of Silence once came to the rainforest to establish a collaboration with the Akademiya, but as time went by, the sages gradually became corrupt and foolish.

dialogues.speaker: Alhaitham
dialogues.text: The Temple of Silence felt that they could no longer trust the Akademiya, and ended the partnership. They retreated back to the desert about four hundred years ago.

dialogues.speaker: Alhaitham
dialogues.text: Ever since its inception, the Temple of Silence has been the guardians of King Deshret's civilization and belief system. They traveled throughout Sumeru, sequestering and guarding any wisdom that posed a threat to the people's livelihoods.

dialogues.speaker: Alhaitham
dialogues.text: At its roots, it was a legitimate and reputable organization whose purpose was to guide people towards the right path.

dialogues.speaker: Tighnari
dialogues.text: ...The Akademiya of the day knew that the split would damage their reputation if it became a matter of public knowledge. And so, they set up a dummy organization of their own to conceal the truth.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Not only that, but they managed to keep up the charade for hundreds of years...

dialogues.speaker: Tighnari
dialogues.text: So how did Cyrus become acquainted with the true Temple of Silence if they left centuries ago?

dialogues.speaker: Kaveh
dialogues.text: I'll bet that's the question that bothered Cyno. Probably why he went after him in such a rush.

dialogues.speaker: Alhaitham
dialogues.text: Whoever is behind this, getting Urraca to extort Cyrus was only the first step of the plan. Their true goal in doing so was for Cyrus to see the emblem on the letter.

dialogues.speaker: Kaveh
dialogues.text: He must have recognized it right away. That'll be why he didn't want to involve the authorities. He probably hoped to take care of the whole thing by himself... Unfortunately for him, Cyno had other plans.

dialogues.speaker: Alhaitham
dialogues.text: Since the desert is where the Temple of Silence originated, that is in all likelihood where Cyrus went.

dialogues.speaker: Tighnari
dialogues.text: ...I have to go after him.

dialogues.speaker: Kaveh
dialogues.text: Really? Are you sure that's a good idea, with how you respond to the heat? Why don't we send someone else?

dialogues.speaker: Tighnari
dialogues.text: I should be fine as long as I bring plenty of water. Besides, I just can't shake this ominous feeling that if we don't catch up to them soon... *sigh*

dialogues.speaker: Naphis
dialogues.text: Everyone, I have news from the Corps of Thirty.

dialogues.speaker: Tighnari
dialogues.text: Master.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh, so that's Naphis, Tighnari's Master? Whoa, we're finally getting to meet him in person.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Hello.

dialogues.speaker: Naphis
dialogues.text: #It's a pleasure to meet you, {NICKNAME} and Paimon.

dialogues.speaker: Naphis
dialogues.text: Several independent eyewitnesses have reported seeing Cyrus and Mahamatra Cyno leaving the city at different times. Both were heading in the direction of Caravan Ribat.

dialogues.speaker: Naphis
dialogues.text: I was going to suggest that you join forces with the Corps of Thirty in this case, however... as I'm sure you've already heard from Alhaitham and Kaveh, the Temple of Silence is involved.

dialogues.speaker: Naphis
dialogues.text: The Akademiya has made a number of decisions throughout history that I am ashamed to talk about. It may well be that no better choice was available to them, but those actions are nonetheless a stain on our legacy.

dialogues.speaker: Naphis
dialogues.text: I won't attempt to make you understand the Akademiya's perspective. Now is the time for action.

dialogues.speaker: Tighnari
dialogues.text: I understand where you're coming from, Master, but I'm afraid the situation might be more complicated than we thought. I think... we need to keep a low profile, or risk making things worse.

dialogues.speaker: Naphis
dialogues.text: ...Good point. If Cyrus is involved with the other side... Or worse, if he's fallen into their hands, and...

dialogues.speaker: Naphis
dialogues.text: *sigh* Everyone, we have to get Cyrus and Cyno back safely. We cannot afford to lose them.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Need our help? Whatever you need, we got you covered!

dialogues.speaker: Naphis
dialogues.text: Really? Wonderful, you have my most sincere gratitude.

dialogues.speaker: Naphis
dialogues.text: Aarav and I will continue to follow up on the lead from Urraca. Kaveh, Scribe Alhaitham, I'd like to ask you to cover the duties of the House of Daena.

dialogues.speaker: Naphis
dialogues.text: Tighnari. You're planning to go into the desert, correct?

dialogues.speaker: Tighnari
dialogues.text: I am. Kaveh, I'll be okay. You stay behind to help Master and Alhaitham.

dialogues.speaker: Kaveh
dialogues.text: Well, if you're sure... Okay. But be careful.

dialogues.speaker: Naphis
dialogues.text: Thank you all. Aarav, let's go.

dialogues.speaker: Alhaitham
dialogues.text: You'd better get moving. Don't forget to ask for help when you need it.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Will do! Let's go, Tighnari. Hopefully we can catch up with Cyno before it's too late.

dialogues.speaker: Tighnari
dialogues.text: Knowing him, he's probably covered a fair distance already. But we still have a shot. Let's take it.

dialogues.speaker: Kaveh
dialogues.text: There's a lot of strange things about this situation. Ugh, what a mess.

dialogues.speaker: Kaveh
dialogues.text: Lemme think... current and former associates would be a good place to start... Argh, but how would I know who Cyrus is acquainted with? Cyno didn't mention any names, either.

dialogues.speaker: Kaveh
dialogues.text: ...We just have to work with what we've got, I suppose.

dialogues.speaker: Kaveh
dialogues.text: Huh? What's that you're reading?

dialogues.speaker: Alhaitham
dialogues.text: An index of the Akademiya's book collection. I recall there being some books that reference the Temple of Silence, but they're few and far between.

dialogues.speaker: Kaveh
dialogues.text: ...How long's that gonna take you? It's like looking for a needle in a haystack!

dialogues.speaker: Alhaitham
dialogues.text: I'll manage.

dialogues.speaker: Kaveh
dialogues.text: Alright, fine! I'll help you look through them. We'll be here all night otherwise.

dialogues.speaker: Alhaitham
dialogues.text: It's a shame there's no coffee around here.

dialogues.speaker: Kaveh
dialogues.text: *sigh* If I'd known what we were getting into, I would have made some before leaving the house...

dialogues.speaker: Kaveh
dialogues.text: Actually... Alhaitham, have you ever met anyone from the Temple of Silence? The phonies from the Akademiya branch, I mean.

dialogues.speaker: Alhaitham
dialogues.text: A few times. Their workload is even lighter than mine, so they often leave the office to chat with whoever's nearby.

dialogues.speaker: Kaveh
dialogues.text: How do you know all this? Do you join in with these chats?

dialogues.speaker: Alhaitham
dialogues.text: Is that a serious question? I just go about my business and pretend not to have heard anything they said.

dialogues.speaker: Kaveh
dialogues.text: Wait, but how does that work? Can you teach me? I feel like that'd be a really useful skill...

dialogues.speaker: Kaveh
dialogues.text: Hey! Stop ignoring me!

dialogues.speaker: Alhaitham
dialogues.text: See? That's all there is to it.

dialogues.speaker: Zaha Hadi
dialogues.text: I can't believe this is happening to Cyrus, of all people... How does a man of his age end up at the center of all this fuss?

dialogues.speaker: Zaha Hadi
dialogues.text: He always seemed so carefree. Cyno and his friends visit him on a regular basis, and there's never any drama. I honestly thought he lived a worry-free life.

dialogues.speaker: Zaha Hadi
dialogues.text: *sigh* We've had our quarrels, but it's always over the silliest little things. Now he's in real trouble, I just wish there was some way I could help.

dialogues.speaker: Zaha Hadi
dialogues.text: And... Oh, what about our tomato-growing contest? He has to see it through! His plants are doing so well... but they need their gardener to come back safe and sound.

dialogues.speaker: Collei
dialogues.text: Mr. Asfand!

dialogues.speaker: Asfand
dialogues.text: Collei! What's wrong?

dialogues.speaker: Collei
dialogues.text: We've got an emergency! Mahamatra Cyno and former Sage Cyrus have gone missing... They could be in danger!

dialogues.speaker: Collei
dialogues.text: Are you able to spare some people to keep the city secure? And also keep an eye out in case they show up?

dialogues.speaker: Asfand
dialogues.text: My goodness... Understood. I'll get on the case immediately.

dialogues.speaker: Collei
dialogues.text: If you have any questions, be sure to contact the Akademiya.

dialogues.speaker: Asfand
dialogues.text: Will do. Don't worry, Miss Collei — we'll do everything in our power to find them.

dialogues.speaker: Collei
dialogues.text: Got it! Thank you so much!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Time to set off! Let's head to the southeast of Gandharva Ville and meet up with the others.

dialogues.speaker: Tighnari
dialogues.text: Cyrus has been living in the city lately. He rented a place near the field so he can keep an eye on his tomato plants.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Then let's go look for him there!

dialogues.speaker: Zaha Hadi
dialogues.text: (Oh Cyrus, you've given me a real fright this time...)

dialogues.speaker: Kaveh
dialogues.text: (I'm suddenly getting really sleepy... My fault for going to bed so late last night.)

dialogues.speaker: Kaveh
dialogues.text: (I wonder if I can send Mehrak to fetch us some coffee? Yeah, if I write the order down, that could work...)

dialogues.speaker: Alhaitham
dialogues.text: (The Temple of Silence... No publications have mentioned this organization in quite some time. The dummy organization at the Akademiya did the job and made sure the subject never attracted any attention.)

dialogues.speaker: Alhaitham
dialogues.text: (Still, there's a lot of material to sift through. I should get a cup of coffee before I start.)

dialogues.speaker: Collei
dialogues.text: (I really hope the others manage to catch up to them...)

dialogues.speaker: Asfand
dialogues.text: (Sir Cyrus and Mahamatra Cyno, missing? Something huge must be afoot if those two are in trouble. We've got to act fast.)
